module: Flowgraph node "Vehicle Group by Performance Class" (category once_instant, author BeamNG, tags career/race/class/vehicle). Generates a vehicle group for a performance class. Input: class (string class name, or number 1-based index, clamped to the list of gameplay_vehiclePerformance.getClassNames()). Outputs: vehGroup (vehicleGroupData table) and aggressionCoef (AI aggression multiplier). If the active mission defines generateVehicleGroup, it is used (editor vehicle selection filters); otherwise career_modules_vehicleClassGrouping.generateGroup. Depends on career_modules_vehicleClassGrouping and gameplay_vehiclePerformance.

workOnce.desc: Converts the numeric class to a name, generates the vehicle group (mission or grouping module) and also outputs the aggression coefficient.
